comments.text:
IGN's top 5 reasons for negatively reviewing the next incredibly well-received game (mouse: PI for hire): 
"1. The game wouldn't stop with jokes, making it hard to take the clearly advertised as silly game seriously.
2. It references the media it was inspired by 
3. OH OH I GOT ONE! In this one part, there was an alligator in a sewer which REALLY pissed me off fsr
4. The developers put way too much effort into making the player have fun, even going as far as making characters that are aware they're in a game. Almost feels like there's 🤢 passion 🤮
5. "Waiter, waiter, why does my shooter game have more shooting than puzzles?" 
Honorable mention: the developer didn't pay us off"

These are concerningly accurate reframings of what they ACTUALLY said btw. 

(Yo why is autocorrect flagging "concerningly?" Seems like a word to me)
